text:
Eli: Heads-up — nightly invoice job run_2026_03_20_02 produced multiple malformed invoices: missing prorated seat lines and 9 duplicate PDFs delivered. Opening thread for triage.
Harper: on it. any sample invoice ids or customer accounts?
Eli: samples: INV-SOL-0099, INV-ARC-0028, INV-REW-077. Affected accounts: acct-solaris, acct-archai, acct-rework.
Nina: support got first ticket from Solaris at 08:22 UTC — their invoice PDF is missing the middle table with seat charges.
Owen: I pulled renderer logs. We have a retry loop that requeued render jobs without the idempotency key when PageOverflowException occurs. That explains duplicates and partial writes.
Owen: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:20:11Z ERROR render: PageOverflowException invoice=INV-SOL-0099
2026-03-20T08:20:12Z WARN queue: requeued job job=52781 idempotency_key=null
2026-03-20T08:20:13Z INFO store: tmp write inv_INV-SOL-0099_partial.pdf
```
Eli: that's consistent with customer PDFs — partial write then second file. Nina, please halt collections for the affected accounts.
Nina: collections paused for acct-solaris, acct-archai, acct-rework and two others I found. I'll add a temporary hold tag.
Pat: finance exposure estimate?
Eli: quick scan ~ $980 across these customers (mostly seat proration and one migration credit). Will confirm after list.
Owen: proposed hotfix: 1) propagate idempotency_key through billing -> render pipeline 2) make render writes atomic (tmp + rename) 3) backfill tool to regenerate and dedupe. I'd estimate 60-90m to deploy + run backfill.
Harper: please pause nightly runner until fix is live.
Owen: paused with `systemctl stop invoice-batcher` on batch02. Deploy started for branch billing/fix-render-idempotency.
deploy-bot: Deploy started billing/fix-render-idempotency -> staging
Harper: support to customers — avoid sending corrected invoices until regen complete. cs will prepare a holding message and offer a $20 courtesy credit.
Owen: ran dry-run backfill: found 34 invoices with missing lines, 9 true duplicate PDFs. command: `python billing/tools/backfill_invoices.py --run run_2026_03_20_02 --dry-run` output summarized.
Eli: good. once backfill runs, finance will issue credits. hold off on posting until we have final numbers.
deploy-bot: Deploy to prod succeeded @ 2026-03-20T09:45:02Z
Owen: prod backfill completed: regenerated 34 invoices, removed 9 duplicates, uploaded corrected PDFs, queued emails for resend. summary: regenerated=34 deduped=9 duration=27m
Pat: finance prepared $1,020 in credits. attaching approval PO-4812. I'll run journals after CS confirmation.
Nina: CS will send batch notifications this afternoon with corrected PDFs and the credit applied. Template posted in #support.
Eli: please add a short incident note for postmortem: root cause = missing idempotency propagation + non-atomic PDF writes. Owners: Owen (fix + backfill), Nina (customer comms), Pat (credits). Closing until postmortem.
